whatThisSettles: is_active MOVES. It is not a property of the limit kind, so nothing may be keyed on it. Between the two recorded readings the true element changed, and a third observation during development at 2026-08-06T02:50Z (not captured, so weaker evidence) showed a third arrangement again. The most plausible reading is that it marks whichever window is currently binding, but this file does not establish that, and a renderer built on the wrong guess would label the 5h window as the live constraint on one day and the weekly one the next with nothing to say which was right. That is why quota.py parses limits[] and publishes neither is_active nor severity.
